Hello ILP Community,

Myself and some of my colleagues from Blockchain at Berkeley and Dekrypt Capital will be hosting the 3rd annual Cryptoeconomics Security Conference (CESC) as part of San Francisco Blockchain Week (SFBW) 2019!

We recently opened up our call for papers for CESC. If you are interested in submitting a research paper please follow this link which outlines details for submitting papers. It would be great if we could have some ILP related research presented at the conference.

On another note, if your company is interested in sponsorship of SFBW and/or CESC please check out this link and send me an email at adiprinzio@berkeley.edu. I’m more than happy to answer any questions that you might have pertaining to both sponsorship and/or the call for papers.

Cheers,
Anthony
